entry.title: Liechtenstein Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected exterior picture supports the tall west keep, pale masonry, tiled palace wings, south arcade and slimmer east tower. Retained east/south map geometry sets approximate footprint, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the ridge; main architecture is raised3m above its coarse crest, bounded toes reach sampled ground, lower gate/auxiliary floors clear it and court routes/walls share the sampler across levels. The natural ridge is supplied by host terrain. Anchor 16.270299868,48.092690906; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 302.080059918783m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
